categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in hazardous industrial waste removal and treatment, including solidification and excavation services, landfill services, waste transportation, recycled paper sales, ready-mixed concrete sales, and solar power generation. It also engages in soil and groundwater pollution control and remediation, and renewable energy development such as photovoltaic and bioenergy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes patented technologies for treating mercury-contaminated soil, oily soil, and volatile organic compound wastewater. It employs solidification, thermal treatment, and resource recycling technologies for hazardous waste. It also develops renewable energy technologies including SRF power plants and solar power installations, and integrates AI and digital platforms for environmental management and waste tracking.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include steel, electronics, optoelectronics, petrochemical, electroplating, leather processing, and metal processing industries, as well as government agencies. The company serves domestic industrial clients requiring hazardous waste treatment and environmental remediation, and also markets recycled paper products and renewable energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with some sales of recycled paper to China, Vietnam, Malaysia, and other regions. It has facilities and subsidiaries located mainly in Kaohsiung and Chiayi, Taiwan, and has investment holdings in mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental services supply chain, providing waste collection, treatment, solidification, and final disposal services. It also extends upstream into resource recycling and renewable energy generation, integrating vertically with waste transportation and landfill operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding hazardous waste treatment capacity, advancing pollution site remediation, and developing circular economy initiatives. R&D focuses on patented soil and wastewater treatment technologies, lithium battery recycling, and waste-to-energy processes. The company also emphasizes digital transformation with AI and smart environmental platforms to enhance operational efficiency and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees for hazardous waste treatment, landfill disposal, waste transportation, and environmental remediation contracts. Additional income comes from sales of recycled paper products, ready-mixed concrete, and electricity generated from solar and SRF power plants. The company also earns investment income from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in Taiwan's hazardous waste solidification and landfill market, with higher processing capacity and broader waste categories than competitors. Competitors include other private solidification plants and steel industry recycling firms. The company’s integrated one-stop service and advanced patented technologies provide competitive advantages in a market with high entry barriers due to regulatory and technical requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.17 billion, a 21.19% increase from the previous year, and net operating profit growth of 14.13%. Total assets grew by about 31%, driven by investments in renewable energy facilities. The company maintains a stable profitability profile with a net profit margin around 22.7% and earnings per share of NT$10.70, reflecting steady growth and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers comprehensive, integrated hazardous waste management solutions combining collection, treatment, and final disposal with patented advanced technologies. Its vertical integration and digital transformation initiatives reduce operational complexity and improve efficiency. Commitment to sustainability, regulatory compliance, and innovation in circular economy and renewable energy projects differentiate it as a leader in environmental protection services.
